identity_evidence.quote: A 45‐year‐old male with von Zumbusch‐type generalized pustular psoriasis (GPP)

attribution_limitations: The text states an admission during a 2005 flare-up and later a November 2023 flare-up, then says secukinumab was introduced on day 14 of "his admission" without naming the admission. The Figure 1B caption calls the 2017 dose the first dose and the drug was continued until July 2023, so the introduction follows that discontinuation; the text never states the admission date or that the biopsy belongs to it.
The 1-week resolution and later 18-month clearance follow the day-14 secukinumab start but no calendar dates are given for them.
Discussion cites other published patients (Liao, Khosravi-Hafshejani, Herrero-Moyano); these are literature cases, not this patient.
